key_impacts: People in Japan were afflicted and continue to bear damage from the Fukushima nuclear disaster.
Coolant water became extremely contaminated and leaked into reactor building basements.
The Fukushima Daiichi site is packed with 1,000-ton tanks storing contaminated water due to ongoing inflow.
Complete decontamination is stated to be impossible.
evidence_snippets: Large-scale nuclear disaster at TEPCO-operated Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant, directly caused by the March 11, 2011 earthquake and tsunami.
Coolant water flushes lethal ash out; it becomes extremely contaminated and then leaks into the basement of the building housing the reactor.
The whole site of Fukushima Daiichi has been completely packed with 1,000 ton capacity tanks containing the contaminated water.
missing_information: Exact casualty or displacement figures missing.
Specific affected towns or exclusion zones beyond the plant not listed.
Event end date not specified; ongoing impacts described.
